subject: Firefighters Union Contract and Charter Commission Petition
overview: The Council approved the first reading of a new four-year contract for the firefighters union and authorized a Home Rule Petition to initiate a charter review process. The body also appropriated funds for roof repairs at City Hall and the Public Library and addressed neighborhood public safety concerns.

items.title: Firefighters Union Compensation Plan
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of an ordinance implementing a new contract for IAFF Local 1032, estimated to cost approximately $1 million through June 2015.

items.title: Fire Department Email System
items.summary: Approved a request for the Mayor to establish an interdepartmental email system for the fire department to replace current paper-based notification methods.

items.title: Firefighter Contract Funding Transfer
items.summary: Approved the transfer of $554,000 from the negotiated salary account and $446,000 from certified free cash to fund retroactive payments and raises for the firefighters contract.

items.title: City Hall Roof and Interior Repairs
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $190,000 from free cash for architectural design and construction documents for City Hall repairs, including the roof, cupola, and council chamber ceiling.

items.title: Business and Driver Licenses
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for the AC Hotel by Marriott, a Keno To Go monitor license for NK Convenience, and a taxicab driver license for Hicham Hamdi.

items.title: Public Library Roof Investigation and Expansion
items.summary: Approved $18,000 for a structural analysis of the library roof to address leaks and evaluate the feasibility of expanding the building's second floor.

items.title: Charter Commission Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Approved a Home Rule Petition seeking state authority to elect a Charter Commission to review the city’s governing document, passing with a 4-3 vote.

items.title: Televised Committee Meetings
items.summary: Approved a resolution to televise Committee of the Whole meetings for increased transparency and referred the matter to the Subcommittee on Rules.

items.title: Public Safety Notification and Summit
items.summary: Approved resolutions to improve neighborhood crime notifications and conduct a public safety summit, amended to require 2015 crime and overdose data reports from the Police Chief.

items.title: Parking Permits and Oakland Street Signage
items.summary: Discussed resident parking pass grievances with a local citizen and approved a resolution to install school zone and resident-access signage on Oakland Street to mitigate cut-through traffic.

items.title: LoConte Rink and Transit Facilities
items.summary: Approved requests for updates on the potential privatization of the LoConte Rink and for a meeting with the Department of Transportation regarding the relocation of local bus stops.

items.title: Message Board and Pothole Maintenance
items.summary: Approved the removal of a message board at Winthrop and High Street and discussed the reporting of sinkholes and potholes to the Department of Public Works.

items.title: Minutes and Recognition
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from February 23 and issued a citation recognizing Susan D. for 25 years of service on the Cemetery Board of Trustees.
